_readme: Edit the words, products, FAQs and contact details for the magazine page here, then run `npm run build:magazine` (or push to GitHub and the build workflow regenerates the page). See docs/magazine/EDITING.md.

site._indexingHelp: Leave as "staging" until launch. "staging" adds noindex to every magazine page and keeps it out of sitemap.xml. Change to "production" only when the page is approved and live at lyfemoment.store/magazine/.

analytics._help: Paste only real IDs from your own accounts. Empty means no script or tag is added.

booking._help: A booking button appears only when a URL is filled in AND verified is true. Until then visitors use the publishing inquiry form.

intro.heading: More than a gift. A story worth keeping.
intro.copy: The inside jokes. The big milestones. The everyday photos you keep coming back to. Bring them together in a keepsake that celebrates your person, your people, or your own next chapter.

directory.heading: Find your kind of keepsake.
directory.copy: Explore personalized magazines, photo keepsakes, and thoughtful finishing touches.

products.name: Custom Magazine
products.shortDescription: A personalized magazine concept built around someone's photos, stories, and milestones.
products.longDescription: This is the heart of the collection: a magazine made around one person, one couple, or one group of friends. Picture a cover with their name in the masthead, pages that move through the moments you choose, and words that sound like the people who know them best. It is a keepsake meant to be read, passed around, and saved, whether it becomes a custom birthday magazine, an anniversary magazine, a friendship magazine, or a graduation keepsake.
products.intendedUse: A centerpiece gift for a milestone birthday, anniversary, graduation, or a celebration of someone you love.
personalization: Captions, inside jokes, and favorite quotes

products.name: Magazine Templates
products.shortDescription: A starting layout for arranging a personal cover story and memorable pages.
products.longDescription: Not sure where to begin? A template gives you a designed starting point: a cover style, page layouts, and places for photos and words. You choose the direction and bring the story, so the finished pages still feel completely personal.
products.intendedUse: For anyone who wants a clear structure to fill with their own photos and words.
personalization: Headlines and captions in your words

products.name: Pocket Magazine
products.shortDescription: A compact keepsake concept for a collection of favorite moments.
products.longDescription: A smaller format for a shorter story. It suits a handful of favorite photos, a heartfelt note, or a quick look back at a season together. Easy to tuck into a card, a bag, or a gift box.
products.intendedUse: A thoughtful small gift, a party favor idea, or a companion to a larger keepsake.
personalization: A short collection of favorite photos

products.name: Newspaper-Style Magazine
products.shortDescription: A headline-inspired format for milestones, announcements, and personal stories.
products.longDescription: Big headlines, columns of stories, and photos laid out like the front page. This format makes any milestone feel like breaking news, from a graduation announcement to a front-page tribute for someone's big birthday.
products.intendedUse: Announcements, milestone tributes, and celebrations that deserve a headline.
personalization: Stories and announcements in your words

products.name: Love Sticker Book
products.shortDescription: A playful concept for collecting affectionate notes and shared memories.
products.longDescription: Part keepsake, part activity. Imagine pages waiting to be filled with photo stickers and little notes, put together one memory at a time. It is a sweet way to celebrate a relationship or a friendship and enjoy making it together.
products.intendedUse: A gift for a partner or best friend that you finish together.

products.name: Photo Cards
products.shortDescription: A simple way to pair a favorite image with a meaningful message.
products.longDescription: One photo and the words that go with it. A photo card can travel with a larger gift or stand on its own as a note someone keeps on the fridge, the desk, or the mirror.
products.intendedUse: A message to go with a gift, or a small keepsake on its own.

products.name: Instant-Style Photo Prints
products.shortDescription: A nostalgic photo-print concept for memorable snapshots.
products.longDescription: The familiar look of an instant snapshot, with a white border and room for a short caption. They are made for pinning up, tucking into a magazine, or handing out as little reminders of a great day.
products.intendedUse: Decor, scrapbooks, gift add-ins, and party keepsakes.

products.name: Single & Duo Cards
products.shortDescription: Personal keepsake cards for a message, a memory, or a pair of favorite photos.
products.longDescription: Choose one photo for a single moment or two side by side for a then-and-now, a you-and-me, or a before-and-after. Add a line or two that says exactly what you mean.
products.intendedUse: Then-and-now comparisons, couple and friendship cards, or a personal note.

products.name: Classic Photo Print Packs
products.shortDescription: A coordinated collection of photographs worth revisiting.
products.longDescription: A set of your chosen photos, printed to be held, shared, and revisited. A print pack pairs well with a magazine or works as a simple gift for someone who would love to see the photos off the screen.
products.intendedUse: Sharing a set of favorite photos or completing a larger gift.

products.name: Photo Strips
products.shortDescription: A sequence of moments presented in a photo-booth-inspired layout.
products.longDescription: A short run of photos stacked in a narrow strip, like the ones from a photo booth. It tells a tiny story in a few frames and makes a sweet bookmark, favor, or add-in.
products.intendedUse: Favors, bookmarks, and small add-ins for a bigger gift.
personalization: A name, date, or short line

products.name: Add-ons & Gifts
products.shortDescription: Thoughtful finishing touches to complement a keepsake.
products.longDescription: Small details that help the whole gift feel considered, such as a personal note or a coordinated finishing touch. The available extras will be listed here as the collection comes together.
products.intendedUse: Completing a magazine or photo keepsake gift.

products.name: Curated Bundles
products.shortDescription: Coordinated keepsake combinations for a meaningful gift.
products.longDescription: A magazine with matching photo keepsakes, gathered so the whole gift tells one story. Bundles make it easy to give something complete without choosing every piece separately.
products.intendedUse: A complete gift for a milestone, chosen as one coordinated set.
personalization: Everything you would personalize in each included piece

items.question: What can I personalize?
items.answer: Photos, names, messages, and the details that make the story yours, such as captions, favorite quotes, and inside jokes. Each keepsake page lists what can be personalized for that format.

items.question: What photos and text should I prepare?
items.answer: Start by gathering your favorite photos of the person or group, with the clearest, best-lit versions you have. Write down names exactly as they should appear, along with any messages, dates, or memories you want to include. It helps to choose a few favorites to lead with, like a cover photo.

items.question: Can I create a magazine as a gift?
items.answer: Yes. These keepsakes are designed with gifting in mind, whether it is for a birthday, an anniversary, a graduation, or simply someone you want to celebrate.

sections.heading: Privacy notice for magazine inquiries
paragraphs: When you send an inquiry from the magazine page, we receive the details you enter: your name, email address, the keepsake and occasion you are interested in, an optional quantity and date, your project notes, and whether you asked to receive marketing emails.

We use these details to reply to your inquiry and to plan your project with you. We do not sell your information. If you opt in to marketing emails, we may also send occasional updates, and you can unsubscribe at any time.
Please do not include payment details, health information, or children's personal details in an inquiry. We do not accept photo uploads through this form.
To ask about, correct, or delete the information you sent, email hello@lyfemoment.store.

sections.heading: Ordering, shipping, and returns
paragraphs: Personalized magazines and keepsakes are not yet available to order online. Formats, prices, production times, shipping, and return or revision terms will be published here and on each product page before ordering opens.
